$comment: Pose catalogue: source of truth for scripts/prepare-character.mjs. Coordinates are SOURCE pixels of each pose image. Drop new renders into assets-src/character/poses/<id>.png and run `npm run assets:character`. Poses whose source file is missing are skipped and the site falls back to 01-standing.

scale.$why: Every pose is scaled by head height (crown→chin) so the character keeps the same size in every image.

promptPreamble: Use the attached image as the exact identity and outfit reference. Keep the same young man: natural curly black hair, the same face, eyebrows, eyes and nose, the same moustache and light beard, the same natural skin tone and friendly expression. Same outfit: light grey pullover hoodie with drawstrings and a kangaroo pocket, dark black tapered trousers, clean white low-top sneakers. Same semi-realistic 3D CGI character render style, realistic human proportions (do not enlarge the head), natural hands with five fingers, the same soft studio lighting from the front-left and the same colour grading. Full body visible from hair to shoes, nothing cropped, generous empty margin around the figure. Plain flat pure white background (#FFFFFF), no floor, no horizon, no cast shadow on the background, no text, no watermark. Portrait 2:3, at least 1536 px tall, PNG.

poses.hands: Relaxed at sides, slightly away from the hips
poses.legs: Straight, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out
poses.transitions: Base pose. Rigged for breathing, head motion, lean, arm swing, crouch/launch/land and the seated foreshortening illusion.

poses.camera: Three-quarter front from his left (he faces slightly toward screen-right), camera at seated chest height
poses.posture: Sitting upright on an invisible ledge, slight forward lean, focused
poses.hands: Both forearms forward at lap height, fingers curved as if typing on a laptop resting on his thighs
poses.legs: Thighs horizontal toward camera, knees bent 90°, lower legs hanging straight down, feet relaxed
props: 3D laptop on lap (rendered by WebGL, NOT in the image)
giant sculptural hand as the seat
poses.transitions: Hero idle. Lid closes in 3D, then blends into 03 (similar silhouette).
poses.prompt: Pose: sitting on the edge of an invisible ledge, thighs horizontal and pointing toward the camera, knees bent at 90 degrees, lower legs hanging straight down, both forearms held forward at lap height with fingers curved as if typing on a laptop on his thighs, eyes looking down at that imaginary screen, calm focused expression. IMPORTANT: do NOT draw the laptop, seat or ledge; the hands type on nothing. Camera: three-quarter front view from his left side so he faces slightly to the right of the frame, camera at seated chest height, 50 mm lens.

poses.posture: Seated, torso leaning forward, weight moving onto the feet
poses.legs: As 02 but feet planted slightly back
poses.transitions: From 02 by soft blend (matching silhouette); into the launch of 04 on a fast camera move.
poses.prompt: Pose: still seated on an invisible ledge as in a laptop-working pose, but now leaning the torso forward, both palms pressing on his knees, about to stand up, eyes looking ahead and slightly up, a small confident smile. Do NOT draw any seat, ledge or laptop. Camera: three-quarter front view from his left side, camera at seated chest height, 50 mm lens.

poses.hands: Arms spread out for balance, fingers open
poses.legs: Knees tucked, one leg higher than the other
poses.transitions: Swapped in at peak velocity with motion smear; out into 07 at touchdown.
poses.prompt: Pose: mid-air dynamic jump, leaping forward and to the right of the frame, knees tucked up, right knee higher than the left, arms spread wide for balance with open hands, hoodie fabric lifting slightly from the motion, excited expression. Feet do not touch anything. Camera: three-quarter front view, slightly low angle looking up, 50 mm lens.

poses.posture: Leaning into a push, back straight
poses.hands: Both arms extended forward at chest height, palms flat as if pushing a heavy desk
poses.transitions: Paired with the 3D desk translating; camera keeps the angle constant.
poses.prompt: Pose: pushing a heavy object forward with both hands, arms extended at chest height, palms flat, body leaning into the push at about 20 degrees, staggered stance with the rear leg extended behind, determined expression. Do NOT draw the object being pushed. Camera: side three-quarter view from his right, eye level, 50 mm lens.

poses.camera: Three-quarter rear from his left, slightly high
poses.hands: Left hand on keyboard, right hand on mouse at desk height
poses.legs: Seated, knees bent, feet on the floor
props: gaming chair, desk, monitor, PC tower (3D)
poses.transitions: Camera matches the angle; chair is 3D and occludes the hips.
poses.prompt: Pose: sitting at an invisible desk as if in an office chair, upright, left hand resting on an imaginary keyboard and right hand on an imaginary mouse at desk height, looking at a screen in front of him. Do NOT draw the chair, desk, monitor or any device. Camera: three-quarter rear view from his left side, slightly above eye level, so we see his back, the side of his face and his hands, 50 mm lens.

poses.hands: Right fingertips touching the ground, left arm out for balance
poses.transitions: Out of 04 at touchdown; rises into 08 through the 01 rig (crouch → stand).
poses.prompt: Pose: landing from a jump in a deep crouch, knees bent, feet wide apart, right fingertips touching the ground, left arm out to the side for balance, looking straight at the camera with a confident smile. Camera: front view, eye level, 50 mm lens.

poses.hands: Both hands in the hoodie's kangaroo pocket
poses.legs: Straight, weight slightly on one leg
poses.transitions: Idle in front of the Creative Developer typography.
poses.prompt: Pose: standing upright and relaxed, both hands in the front pocket of the hoodie, weight slightly on his right leg, looking at the camera with a confident friendly smile. Camera: front view, eye level, 50 mm lens.

poses.hands: Right fist raised overhead, left arm back
poses.legs: Left leg extended down, right knee driven up
poses.transitions: Exits the Creative Developer scene upward; camera follows into Selected Work.
poses.prompt: Pose: superhero-style upward leap, launching diagonally up and to the right of the frame, right fist raised above his head, left arm swept back, right knee driven up and left leg extended down, hoodie and drawstrings flowing with the motion, determined smile. Camera: low angle three-quarter front view, 35 mm lens.

poses.hands: Left arm extended to the side, palm up, presenting; right hand relaxed
poses.transitions: Holds while project panels orbit; head look-at from the rig.
poses.prompt: Pose: standing and presenting something to the side, left arm extended out to his left with an open palm facing up, right hand relaxed by his side, body slightly turned toward the presented side, warm smile looking at the camera. Do NOT draw anything in his hand or beside him. Camera: three-quarter front view from his right, eye level, 50 mm lens.

poses.camera: Three-quarter rear from his left, slightly high
poses.hands: Right hand holding a pencil on paper, left hand flat on the desk
poses.legs: Seated, mostly hidden by the 3D desk
props: wooden desk, wooden chair, pencil, paper (3D)
poses.transitions: Desk scene; camera rises to the overhead wireframe view.
poses.prompt: Pose: sitting at an invisible desk, leaning forward, right hand holding a wooden pencil as if sketching on paper, left hand resting flat on the desk surface, looking down at the drawing, concentrated. Draw the pencil, but do NOT draw the desk, paper or chair. Camera: three-quarter rear view from his left side, slightly above eye level, 50 mm lens.

poses.hands: Right hand raised beside the head, open palm waving; left hand relaxed
poses.transitions: Contact scene greeting; blends back to 01 through the arm rig.
poses.prompt: Pose: standing upright, raising his right hand beside his head with an open palm in a friendly wave, left arm relaxed by his side, big warm smile looking straight at the camera. Camera: front view, eye level, 50 mm lens.
